newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil bourse suspends trade in Banespa.
newsitem.headline: Brazil bourse suspends trade in Banespa.

text.p: Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) suspended trade in troubled Sao Paulo state bank Banespa on Tuesday, a bourse spokeswoman said.
Trade in Banespa was suspended following a Gazeta Mercantil report that the bank showed a net profit of 786.3 million reais in the first nine months of the year.
The newspaper said the figures were included in a report sent by the bank's administrative council to Sao Paulo Finance Secretary Yoshiaki Nakano and Central Bank Director Alkimar Moura.
Banespa has not published its balance sheets since December 1994, when the Central Bank took over management of the bank due to Sao Paulo state's huge debt with it.
A solution for Banespa, allowing the federal government to take over management of the bank, is expected to be announced this week.
